title: Data Science Trainer
description:
TECHWINGSYS is looking for a **Data Science Trainer** with strong knowledge of **Python and Data Science** to join our training team.

The trainer will be responsible for delivering engaging training sessions, assisting students with practical exercises and projects, and supporting their overall learning journey in **Data Science, Python, and Machine Learning**.

Key Responsibilities

* Deliver structured and engaging training sessions on **Python and Data Science**.
* Explain Data Science concepts clearly through practical, real-world examples.
* Assist students with **practical exercises, assignments, and projects**.
* Provide individual guidance and support to help students understand core concepts.
* Help students build **real-time projects and professional portfolios**.
* Conduct assessments, evaluations, and practical reviews to track student performance.
* Identify learning gaps and provide appropriate support to students.
* Guide students in applying Python and Data Science concepts to real-world problems.
* Stay updated with the latest trends, tools, technologies, and developments in **Data Science and Machine Learning**.
* Support students in developing problem-solving and analytical skills.
* Maintain a positive, professional, and engaging learning environment.

Required Skills & Knowledge

* Strong knowledge of **Python programming**.
* Good understanding of **Data Science concepts and fundamentals**.
* Familiarity with Data Science libraries such as:
* **NumPy**
* **Pandas**
* **Matplotlib**
* Basic understanding of **Data Analysis, Data Visualization, and Machine Learning concepts**.
* Ability to explain technical concepts in a simple and understandable manner.
* Good communication and presentation skills.
* Passion for teaching, mentoring, and helping students grow.

Qualifications

* Bachelor's degree in **Computer Science, Information Technology, Data Science**, or a related field.
* **Certification in Data Science or Python** will be an added advantage.

Experience

* **0–2 years of relevant experience** in Data Science, Python development, training, or a related field.
* Freshers with strong practical knowledge and good communication skills may also be considered.

What We Look For

* Strong technical fundamentals
* Practical, project-oriented approach
* Good communication and mentoring ability
* Willingness to continuously learn and upgrade technical skills
* Ability to work with students from different learning levels

How to Apply

**info@techwingsys.com**

**TECHWINGSYS**  
*Let's build tomorrow together.*

title: AI Facilitator
description:
**AI Facilitator**

**About the Role**

The **AI Facilitator** will be responsible for delivering and supporting Artificial Intelligence-focused academic and technical programs across diverse audiences, including schools, colleges, universities, faculty development programs (FDPs), professional training programs, organizations, and customized institutional requirements.

The candidate will combine a strong understanding of AI concepts and practical applications with the ability to design and deliver engaging technical learning experiences, understand institutional requirements, and contribute to AI projects, research, and development initiatives.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Academics & Technical Facilitation**

**1. Training & Program Delivery**

· Conduct AI-focused training programs, workshops, demonstrations, and hands-on sessions for:

o Schools and students

o Colleges and universities

o Faculty and educators

o FDP and professional development programs

o Organizations and corporate teams

o Skill development and institutional programs

o Customized technical training requirements

· Deliver beginner and advanced-level AI programs based on the target audience.

· Facilitate practical, project-based, and experiential learning sessions.

· Explain complex AI concepts in a simple, structured, and engaging manner.

· Conduct demonstrations of AI tools, applications, and real-world use cases.

· Train learners in Generative AI, prompt engineering, machine learning, and AI-powered productivity tools.

**2. Academic Content & Curriculum**

· Develop and update AI training content, lesson plans, practical activities, presentations, and project modules.

· Customize academic content based on institutional requirements and learners' skill levels.

· Support the development of workshops, certification programs, FDPs, add-on courses, and long-term AI programs.

· Incorporate emerging AI technologies, industry trends, and practical applications into training programs.

· Prepare assignments, assessments, project briefs, and evaluation methodologies.

· Develop learning activities using AI tools, datasets, and real-world problem statements.

**3. Project & Student Mentoring**

· Guide learners in developing AI projects from ideation to implementation.

· Mentor participants in problem identification, dataset preparation, model development, testing, and evaluation.

· Support projects involving machine learning, Generative AI, chatbots, computer vision, natural language processing, and AI automation.

· Guide learners in using Python and relevant AI/ML libraries and frameworks.

· Support AI competitions, exhibitions, hackathons, technical events, and project demonstrations.

· Evaluate projects and provide technical feedback and guidance.

**4. Institutional & Organizational Programs**

· Understand the technical and learning requirements of institutions and organizations.

· Support the development and execution of customized AI programs based on client requirements.

· Participate in technical discussions with academic institutions, organizations, faculty, and other stakeholders.

· Assist in preparing technical proposals, program structures, module plans, and training requirements.

· Support the delivery of programs at Inker facilities and external locations.

· Identify opportunities to apply AI tools and solutions to real-world academic and organizational challenges.

**AI R&D & Project Development**

· Participate in internal and client-oriented AI research and development projects.

· Support the development of Proof of Concepts (PoCs), prototypes, AI applications, and intelligent solutions.

· Research emerging AI technologies, models, tools, frameworks, and applications.

· Work on machine learning, Generative AI, LLMs, chatbots, computer vision, NLP, and AI automation, as relevant to project requirements.

· Support data preparation, model development, testing, debugging, evaluation, and deployment.

· Assist in integrating AI models and APIs into applications and workflows.

· Document experiments, technical findings, project iterations, and test results.

· Collaborate with R&D and technical teams on project development and deployment.

· Convert relevant R&D outcomes into practical demonstrations, academic projects, and training modules where applicable.

**Required Technical Skills**

· Understanding of **Artificial Intelligence** and its real-world applications.

· Knowledge of **machine learning fundamentals** and **Generative AI** concepts.

· Programming knowledge in **Python** or other relevant programming languages.

· Familiarity with AI tools, prompt engineering, and AI-assisted productivity applications.

· Understanding of supervised and unsupervised learning, data preprocessing and model evaluation, Generative AI and Large Language Models (LLMs), Natural Language Processing (NLP), computer vision, neural networks and deep learning fundamentals, AI APIs and application integration, and machine learning libraries and frameworks.

· Ability to explore AI tools, develop practical demonstrations, and troubleshoot technical issues.

· Strong analytical thinking, problem-solving, and debugging skills.

· Willingness to learn emerging AI technologies and apply them in practical projects.

*Note: Candidates are not expected to have expertise in every listed area. Practical knowledge, learning ability, and relevant project experience will be considered.*

**Communication & Facilitation Skills**

The candidate should be able to:

· Communicate technical concepts clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.

· Adapt training methodologies according to the audience's knowledge level.

· Confidently conduct classroom, laboratory, workshop, and corporate/organizational sessions.

· Engage participants through demonstrations, practical exercises, and project-based learning.

· Manage technical sessions independently at external locations.

· Interact professionally with faculty, students, institutional representatives, organizational teams, and clients.

· Demonstrate curiosity, initiative, and a willingness to continuously upgrade technical skills.

**Educational Qualification**

**Preferred:**

· Diploma / B.Tech / B.E. / M.Tech in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Information Technology, Electronics, or a related technical field.

Candidates from other academic backgrounds with relevant **AI/ML skills, practical project experience, certifications, or a strong project portfolio** may also be considered.

**Experience**

· Freshers and experienced candidates are welcome to apply.

· Freshers with a strong interest in AI, practical projects, and a willingness to learn are encouraged to apply.

· Experience in AI training, technical facilitation, AI/ML development, project development, or R&D will be preferred.

· Experience conducting **workshops, FDPs, institutional training, corporate technical programs, or customized training** will be an added advantage.

· Candidates with hands-on experience in **Python, machine learning, Generative AI, or AI application development** will have an advantage.

**At Inker Robotics, we welcome enthusiastic freshers and experienced professionals who are passionate about AI, technology, teaching, and innovation.**

Pay: ₹10,000.00 - ₹20,000.00 per month

title: Data Scientist
description:
**Job Requirements**  

**About the Role**
------------------


We are seeking a Data Scientist with 5\+ years of experience to develop machine learning solutions for failure prediction, classification, and fault analysis in semiconductor manufacturing and equipment systems. This role focuses on time\-series modeling, equipment health monitoring, and root\-cause analysis using structured reliability methods such as fault tree analysis (FTA).


You will work with complex, high\-volume data from semiconductor tools (sensor signals, logs, process data) to improve tool uptime, yield, and operational reliability.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Design, develop, and deploy machine learning models for equipment failure prediction and fault classification
* Analyze time\-series data from semiconductor tools (sensor telemetry, logs, process traces)
* Perform advanced feature engineering (lags, rolling windows, trends, seasonality, event\-based features)
* Apply fault tree analysis (FTA) concepts to support root\-cause analysis and improve model interpretability
* Collaborate with process engineers, equipment engineers, and failure analysis teams
* Select, justify, and evaluate appropriate ML algorithms
* Validate models using metrics such as precision/recall, F1\-score, ROC\-AUC, and early failure detection accuracy
* Document models, assumptions, and results for technical and cross\-functional stakeholders
* Mentor junior data scientists and contribute to best practices

  

**Work Experience**  

**Required Qualifications**
---------------------------

* 5\+ years of professional experience as a Data Scientist or Machine Learning Engineer
* Strong proficiency in Python (Pandas, NumPy, scikit\-learn)
* Proven experience with time\-series data modeling
* Hands\-on experience building classification and predictive models
* Experience with failure prediction, reliability analytics, or equipment health monitoring
* Working knowledge of fault tree analysis (FTA) or structured root\-cause analysis
* Strong feature engineering skills for noisy, real\-world industrial data
* Ability to clearly communicate technical results to engineering stakeholders

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* Experience in semiconductor manufacturing or equipment systems (etch, deposition, lithography, inspection, metrology)
* Familiarity with process data, tool logs, alarms, and sensor telemetry
* Experience with survival analysis, RUL estimation, or anomaly detection
* Exposure to model explainability techniques (e.g., SHAP, feature importance)
* Experience deploying models into production or factory systems
* Background in reliability engineering, systems engineering, or failure analysis

**What Success Looks Like**
---------------------------

* Accurate and reliable failure prediction models with low false\-positive rates
* Clear linkage between data\-driven predictions and physical failure mechanisms
* Measurable improvements in tool uptime, yield, and maintenance planning
* Strong collaboration with cross\-functional engineering teams

**Representative Tech Stack**
-----------------------------

* Python (Pandas, NumPy, scikit\-learn)
* Time\-series analysis libraries
* Machine learning frameworks
* Visualization and reporting tools
